skills.name: Return authorization
skills.description: Assess a fictional merchandise return using purchase age, condition, proof of purchase, and item exclusions. Use when a customer asks to return an item or asks whether a purchase is eligible.
skills.content:
---
name: skillscentral-return-authorization
description: Assess a fictional merchandise return using purchase age, condition, proof of purchase, and item exclusions. Use when a customer asks to return an item or asks whether a purchase is eligible.
---

# Return authorization

Fictional SkillsCentral demonstration procedure. This is not a real retailer policy.

1. Ask for order reference, purchase age in days, item condition, and proof of purchase. Do not infer missing eligibility details.
2. The fictional return window is 45 calendar days from purchase. An unworn item with proof of purchase is eligible for review within that window. Final-sale and personalized items require a specialist.
3. For an item outside the return window, explain that standard eligibility is not met and offer specialist review. Do not invent an exception.
4. Give a concise eligibility explanation and the next information the customer should provide. Describe this as an assessment, not an issued return authorization.

Completion: deliver guidance or a handoff only. Do not claim that a business-system action occurred.

skills.name: Store inventory guidance
skills.description: Guide a store-availability request using a customer-provided product, size, color, and store or ZIP code. Do not invent live stock availability.
skills.content:
---
name: skillscentral-inventory-lookup
description: Guide a store-availability request using a customer-provided product, size, color, and store or ZIP code. Do not invent live stock availability.
---

# Store inventory guidance

Fictional SkillsCentral demonstration procedure. This is not a real retailer policy.

1. Collect product reference, size, color, and preferred store or ZIP code.
2. If stock data has not been supplied, say live inventory has not been checked. Ask the associate to verify in the store system.
3. When a supplied stock report lists availability, quote its timestamp and location, and distinguish availability from a reservation.
4. Return the search criteria and a suggested next step. No inventory API or reservation action is connected in this demo.

Completion: deliver guidance or a handoff only. Do not claim that a business-system action occurred.

skills.name: Delivery exception triage
skills.description: Triage a delayed, missing, or delivered-but-not-received parcel from customer-supplied tracking details and delivery time.
skills.content:
---
name: skillscentral-delivery-exception
description: Triage a delayed, missing, or delivered-but-not-received parcel from customer-supplied tracking details and delivery time.
---

# Delivery exception triage

Fictional SkillsCentral demonstration procedure. This is not a real retailer policy.

1. Collect the order reference, last tracking event, its timestamp, and the reported delivery issue.
2. For a delayed parcel, summarize the last supplied event and request carrier investigation. For delivered-but-not-received, ask the customer to check the delivery location and household recipients.
3. Do not promise a refund, replacement, delivery date, or claim to contact a carrier. Escalate high-value or repeated losses for review.
4. Produce a case summary with the missing facts and the appropriate handoff.

Completion: deliver guidance or a handoff only. Do not claim that a business-system action occurred.

name: skillscentral-pickup-handoff
description: Prepare a fictional store-pickup checklist from a supplied ready-for-pickup notice, order reference, and pickup person.
---

# Store pickup handoff

Fictional SkillsCentral demonstration procedure. This is not a real retailer policy.

1. Confirm the customer has a ready-for-pickup notice and collect the order reference and store.
2. Explain that the pickup associate needs the notice and an identity check according to the store process. Do not request full identity-document numbers in chat.
3. If another person will collect the order, ask the customer to confirm authorization through the store channel.
4. Return a checklist. Do not mark an order collected or change fulfillment state.

Completion: deliver guidance or a handoff only. Do not claim that a business-system action occurred.

Fictional SkillsCentral demonstration procedure. This is not a real retailer policy.

1. Ask which refund stage is currently displayed if the customer has not supplied one.

4. Return a concise reply that preserves the supplied status and identifies the next step.

skills.name: Sensitive order escalation
skills.description: Prepare a specialist handoff for a potentially unauthorized retail order without collecting payment secrets or making a fraud verdict.
skills.content:
---
name: skillscentral-fraud-escalation
description: Prepare a specialist handoff for a potentially unauthorized retail order without collecting payment secrets or making a fraud verdict.
---

# Sensitive order escalation

Fictional SkillsCentral demonstration procedure. This is not a real retailer policy.

1. Ask whether the customer recognizes the order and collect only a non-sensitive order reference.
2. Do not request a full card number, security code, account password, or government identifier.
3. If the customer reports an unrecognized order, advise contacting their payment provider through its trusted channel and the retailer specialist team.
4. Summarize the reported concern without labeling the customer fraudulent, reversing a charge, or claiming an account was blocked.

Completion: deliver guidance or a handoff only. Do not claim that a business-system action occurred.

faqs.question: What are the demo customer support hours?
faqs.answer: In this fictional SkillsCentral scenario, customer support is available Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Pacific time. These hours are illustrative and are not a real retailer service commitment.

faqs.question: Where can I find the status of an existing refund?
faqs.answer: For this fictional demo, check the refund stage shown in your order history. If no refund is listed, contact the support team with your order reference. This demo cannot access your order or confirm when funds will reach your bank.

faqs.question: What should I bring to collect a store pickup order?
faqs.answer: In this fictional demo, bring your ready-for-pickup notice and order reference. The pickup associate will confirm identity using the store process. Wait for the ready notice before traveling; this demo does not check live order readiness.
